request.test_input_summary: Paid search query for 'weather api' with result limit 3.

contract_anomalies.description: The live x402 payment challenge contained a trailing newline in the payTo value. Atinamos preserved the anomaly as evidence and normalised surrounding whitespace only for authorization construction.

limitations: This is one timestamped observation of one endpoint invocation.
No USDC settlement was observed; this is not evidence that the seller took payment and failed to deliver.
The observation does not establish that the malformed payTo field caused the HTTP 500 response.
The observation does not establish that x402.direct generally fails or that a later invocation would behave the same way.
No search output was returned, so Atinamos did not assess the quality or relevance of search results.
